Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be haughty
nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches
but on the living God
who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

not to be lifted up in their minds
or to put their hope in the uncertain chances of wealth
but in God who gives us in full measure all things for our use;

先是清洁，后是和平，
温良柔顺，满有怜悯，
多结善果，没有偏见，
没有假冒。
惟獨從上頭來的智慧，
先是清潔，後是和平，

then peaceful
gentle
reasonable
full of mercy and good fruits
without partiality
